question: In the events with more than forty incomes, list the city and country in which the event is happening.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T5.city, T6.state
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget
INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id
INNER JOIN city_info AS T5 ON T4.zip = T5.zip_code
INNER JOIN state_info AS T6 ON T4.zip = T6.zip_code
GROUP BY T1.event_id
HAVING COUNT(T3.expense_id) > 40

INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id
INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T4.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN city_info AS T5 ON T4.zip = T5.zip_code
INNER JOIN state_info AS T6 ON T4.zip = T6.zip_code
GROUP BY T1.event_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.income_id) > 40
